from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib
base=Path('reports/research/510300_industrial_official_cause_explanations_v1')
previous=Path('reports/research/510300_industrial_joint_nonlinear_score_v1')
source=Path('reports/research/510300_industrial_last_period_government_full_quantity_anchor_v1')
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def readj(p):return json.loads(Path(p).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert not base.exists(),'已有实验，禁止改期或重启'
old=readj(previous/'result.json')
assert old['status']=='REJECTED_FROZEN_FIXED_INDUSTRIAL_JOINT_NONLINEAR_NO_PRIMARY_INCREMENT'
assert readj(previous/'固定失败归因结果_E101.json')['original_fixed_rejection_unchanged']
rows=readj(source/'全部79原期_完整原载体量义及保守公开钟与同钟多维状态.json')['rows']
targets=['2020M10','2021M07','2024M04']
queries=[{'economic_period':'2020M10','query':{'q':'2020年1—10月份 国家统计局 解读 工业企业 利润','domains':['stats.gov.cn']}},{'economic_period':'2021M07','query':{'q':'2021年1—7月份 国家统计局 解读 工业企业 利润','domains':['stats.gov.cn']}},{'economic_period':'2024M04','query':{'q':'2024年1—4月份 国家统计局 解读 工业企业 利润','domains':['stats.gov.cn']}}]
selected=[r for r in rows if r['economic_period'] in targets]
assert len(selected)==3 and all(r['current_original_joint_source_qualified'] for r in selected)
protocol={'study_id':'510300_INDUSTRIAL_OFFICIAL_MULTICHANNEL_CAUSE_EXPLANATION_SAME_FIXED_THREE_ORIGINAL_PERIODS_SOURCE_V1','experiment_id':'E102','registered_at':now(),'status':'REGISTERED_PRIMARY_MULTICHANNEL_CAUSE_SOURCE_ONLY_NO_FINANCIAL_CANDIDATE','hypothesis':'相同工业利润增长方向可能来自不同组合的需求/销量、原料与售价、低基数、营业费用/税费、非经营收益与行业结构；必须读当期原解释与同钟已知数量/订单/资金/回款/库存并列，不能将官方解释提升为外生因果或已识别指数预期差。','selection_basis':'2021M07/2024M04来自E92在E100金融标签使用前已列出的利润同增而回收相反原例；2020M10为E93金融前完整恢复原例。经济期固定，不依E100股票收益挑案例，三例只作机制探索、不代表全样本验证。','parents':[{'path':str(p).replace('\\','/'),'sha256':sha(p)} for p in [previous/'result.json',previous/'固定失败归因结果_E101.json',source/'全部79原期_完整原载体量义及保守公开钟与同钟多维状态.json']],'targets_original_periods':targets,'queries_fixed_before_requests':queries,'actual_original_quantities_and_scope_before_requests':[{'economic_period':r['economic_period'],'source_url':r['original_url'],'full_report_available_at':r['original_conservative_knowable_at'],'income_scope':r['income_scope'],'receivable_scope':r['receivable_scope'],'original_quantities':r['original_quantities'],'scope_aligned_original_growth':r['scope_aligned_original_growth']} for r in selected],'budget':{'official_web_queries':3,'different_primary_full_interpretation_first_GETs_max':3,'each_target_attempt_max':1,'image_or_PDF_GETs':0,'authentication':0,'raw_request_retries':0},'acceptance':'真实列示NBS原解读链接、全国正确原经济期、完整正文及自身可见原公开钟；只记录原解释与披露数量、竞争解释和未知，不补原财务量或绑定更早钟。其他年/月、后引和新闻摘要拒绝。','evidence_columns':['需求及销量原解释','原材料成本与售价原解释','低基数与累计/单月区别','费用/政策与非经营收益原解释','行业利润分布与全国母体限制','原回款/应收与库存量及当时问卷/资金背景','官方归因与不可识别因果分开'],'new_financial_candidates':0,'new_model_fits':0,'new_linear_regressions':0,'new_simple_weighted_scores':0,'new_stock_labels':0,'new_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0,'old_E100_fixed_rejection_preserved':True,'original79_1711_1212_preserved':True,'finite_stop':'三个固定官方定位查询和最多三个不同当期完整原解释各一次后结束；缺项UNKNOWN，不换期/标题/链接重试。不因三例叙述给旧19字段表达再次金融拟合或改规则。','historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False,'identified_causal_CSI300_return':'UNKNOWN','actual_cash_received':'UNKNOWN','market_expectation_surprise':'UNKNOWN','independent_validation':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','goal_achieved':False,'new_prospective_forecasts':False,'orders_authorized':False}
base.mkdir(parents=True);(base/'protocol.json').write_text(json.dumps(protocol,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
proposal=previous/'next_experiment.json';assert not proposal.exists()
proposal.write_text(json.dumps({'experiment_id':'E102','status':'REGISTERED_SOURCE_ONLY_NOT_YET_QUERIED','protocol':(base/'protocol.json').as_posix(),'fixed_periods':targets,'new_models':0,'old_rejection_preserved':True,'goal_achieved':False},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'上一目标轮':'PROGRESS：79源门与原1711/1212完整、唯一1212非线性拟合及全部81机会诊断实际完成','E102':'固定三个金融前原例的多渠道原因来源实验已登记','新模型/线性/加权/股票标签/账户/源码预算':0},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
